results.title: Why Don't You See Me?
results.overview: Through the mimicry of a shadow play, a storyteller guides us through the tale of a man willing to do anything to win a woman's attention, mistaking obsession for romance and fear for love.

results.title: Mysterious Origins: The World's First Humans
results.original_title: Mysterious Origins: The World's First Humans
results.overview: Newly discovered ancient superhighways hold secrets that could unlock the origins of humankind. From the icy mountains of Spain to the scorching deserts of Australia, humanity's past is hidden in plain sight - waiting for those brave enough to uncover it. Will we solve the mysteries of our ancient past before it is too late? Prepare to uncover the lost origins and connected cultures that will shock and surprise.

results.title: The Work in Progress
results.overview: Follows Americans engaging in face-to-face conversations about cultural, political, economic, and generational divisions across seven states.

results.title: TJPW Grand Princess '26
results.overview: TJPW Grand Princess '26 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW), held on March 29, 2026, at Ryōgoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan. It was headlined by Miu Watanabe defending the Princess of Princess Championship against Yuki Arai.

results.title: Training Day
results.overview: A tired and hungry Tramp gets the opportunity to work at a movie theater. The Tramp must train in the different positions while dealing with his own clumsiness and a mean boss.

results.title: Mare's Nest
results.overview: Moon travels through a mysterious unexplained world free of adults. Moon meets a scholar turned sage and her translator in a mountain hut, where she tries to understand what is happening, based on a play by Don DeLillo. She meets many others who perform for her, show her a film, give her gifts, show her different possibilities for living. She observes and moves on into an unknown future.

results.title: Arkansas
results.overview: Betty, an assistant accountant working at a small marble workshop, heads to the Arkansas nightclub to see her favourite singer perform. As the hours pass and the singer fails to appear, a microcosm of injustices and unfulfilled desires gradually unfolds around her.

results.title: By Yourself
results.overview: Following a breakup, Syl goes solo camping in the deep woods to unplug and connect with herself. Her solitude turns sinister when she wakes to find a neighboring tent that wasn’t there the night before.

results.title: Ghost in the Machine
results.overview: The untold origins of artificial intelligence lie not in machines but in power, revealing the fantasies behind the hype that got us here and where we go next.

results.title: Penance
results.overview: While traveling through an unsafe land, a Soldier and a Princess take shelter in a seemingly empty cavern.

results.title: Sam Morril: Incorrect
results.overview: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

results.title: Freestyle
results.overview: During a national swimming championship, a teenage boy records his father in an intimate situation with a female team member. He rushes to help the girl on impulse, risking everything he dreams of.

results.title: Autobi
results.overview: A woman searching for her missing sister enters a cursed forest, where buried trauma and terrifying secrets blur the line between reality and nightmare.

results.title: Almost Cupid
results.overview: To get his wings, a newly hired cupid must choose between doing the job and honouring free will after being assigned to save a toxic relationship that shouldn't exist.

results.title: TJPW New-Year Party 2026
results.overview: TJPW New-Year Party 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on January 10, 2026 at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Out There
results.overview: When a 16-year-old astronomy enthusiast witnesses a UFO above her sleepy Welsh seaside town, she ropes in her sceptical best mate and an unhinged ufologist to help her uncover a truth she’s not yet ready to face.

results.title: Corre Um Rio em Mim
results.overview: A River Runs in Me is a stop motion film that follows Jaci, a woman who, crossed by deep pain, begins a journey in search of herself. Among landscapes where dreams, memory and reality intertwine, she seeks in her ancestry and in the reunion with her inner child a possible path to healing.
